Robinhood has opened a waitlist for future crypto wallets — with a beta version this year and full release by 2022. But SEC chair Gary Gensler has his eyes on that payment for order flow. An outright ban is “on the table,” he noted last month.

https://t.co/uGIZnAQTWl

Robinhood has confirmed plans for a crypto wallet to support digital asset withdrawals and NFT transfers. Crypto accounted for half of Robinhood's transaction-based revenue across in the second quarter of this year. Most of it was Dogecoin. https://t.co/uGIZnB8uNT https://t.co/wIVbxvTXOd

Hackers took control of PUBG’s official YouTube channel on Saturday, to promo a Bitcoin and Dogecoin giveaway scam. Elon Musk’s likeness was used to peddle the fake event — and oddly enough, a SpaceX Inspiration4 launch which already took place last month. https://t.co/Xy3tGb7It1

Robinhood execs say a waning surge in Dogecoin trading is the reason for a 35% decline in revenue this quarter. The news led to a 10% drop in share price.
